title: Reference Metadata Output
description: section-ir-0.16 reference-metadata pass: structured bibliography entries for a requested set of citation keys, transcribed from the paper's verbatim reference list. Joined to the citation-relation layer by cite_key.

cite_key.description: The requested citation key, echoed exactly (e.g. '12', 'Vaswani2017'). The join key.

authors.description: Author names in 'Last, First' format (e.g. 'Vaswani, Ashish'). Single-name authors as-is; empty list if unreadable.

venue.description: Publication venue (journal, conference with abbreviation if given, or 'arXiv' for preprints). Empty string if absent.
